hypothesis: A useful descendant of FURNISHER/INTERPHASE is not a cube UI. It is a recursive computational material: an object is a typed BLOCK from outside and a manipulable ROOM from inside; semantic zoom changes computational granularity, typed docking exposes composition, FOLD turns a working subgraph into a reusable abstraction, and RETURN preserves the derivation.
laws: BLOCK ⇄ ROOM: every composite can be operated as one block or entered as its internal graph.
ZOOM ≠ MAGNIFY: GLYPH / BLOCK / ROOM are unequal operational projections of the same graph identity.
DOCK REQUIRES TYPE FIT: direction and port type are checked before a seam exists.
FOLD ≠ FLATTEN: composition creates a reversible abstraction over the same child identities.
MACHINERY STAYS VISIBLE: ports, seams, operators and composite boundaries remain inspectable during use.
GEOMETRY IS A PROJECTION: graph topology and stable node/port identity survive layout changes.
RECIPE ≠ REALITY: materialization exports a declarative connection recipe and never invents physical fit/load/safety.
RETURN CLOSES THE MOVE: graph, composites, view, events and recipe can be returned as evidence.

implemented: Infinite pan/zoom workfield with semantic GLYPH → BLOCK → ROOM levels.
Recursive composite nodes with typed proxy boundary ports that map back to stable child ports.
Click-to-arm typed docking; incompatible direction/type and double-bound inputs reject before mutation.
FOLD selection into a reversible composite without rewriting the primitive graph.
ENTER a composite as scope; zooming to ROOM reveals implementation while the composite boundary remains legible.
FORK a node/composite subtree with cloned internal seams for side-by-side counterfactual variation.
RUN a small safe operator graph without eval; trace exposes executed node/operator/data dependencies.
RECIPE exports declarative topology/ports/operators with explicit physical-safety non-claim.
PLAIN exposes canonical graph state; RETURN exports graph/view/composite/event evidence.
Three useful seeds: FURNISHER compiler path, minimal BLOCK/ROOM transform, and live FIELD route blocks.
boundaries: No claim that zoomable canvases or node graphs are novel by themselves.

Novelty claim is limited to this specific recovered composition: recursive block↔room abstraction + semantic operational zoom + typed seams + reversible folding + evidence/RETURN across digital and future physical projections.
No arbitrary code execution or eval in graph RUN.
No automatic claim that a digital recipe is physically safe, buildable or materially equivalent.
Exact historical product demo video remains unrecovered; surviving YC form contains blank demo/video URL fields.

proof.comparator: 0.1 cube probe + PLAIN canonical graph remain directly inspectable

evidence_gate: Use 0.2 to compose and fold one real multi-step FIELD or HOUSE-safe planning transformation. Pass only if a composite can be understood, reused/forked and re-entered with less translation cost than a static app/panel flow while preserving visible seams and RETURN.
next_if_pass: Transfer the core model—not this canvas UI—into one real host: likely physical configuration compiler, FIELD route composition, or a projection-aware notebook. Then prototype one printable/physical typed port token or joint-pattern witness.
next_if_fail: Keep space-core and typed fold/dock semantics as donor; retire the zoom canvas rather than beautifying it.
